description: A Java class 'DatabaseUpdaterWrapper' that acts as a wrapper around the 'DatabaseUpdater' utility class, providing methods to check for unrun database changes, lock status, and whether updates are required within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: DatabaseUpdaterWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class providing methods for database update status checks and unrun changes retrieval.

methods.name: getUnrunDatabaseChanges
methods.description: Returns a list of unrun database changes from the provided Liquibase provider.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Checks whether the database updater is currently locked.

methods.name: updatesRequired
methods.description: Determines if there are pending database updates that need to be applied.
